ideas.pitch: A procedural text-and-image RPG where players vibe-code custom mechanics into the world in real time using AI prompts.
ideas.title: AuraPrompt RPG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages AI-powered vibe coding directly aligned with the hackathon's core premise, ensuring high engagement during the virtual marketplace bidding round.

ideas.pitch: A two-player hidden role game where LLM companions play on behalf of users, and deception naturally evolves based on player prompts.
ideas.title: Deception Dungeon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the adversarial agent dynamics from winning projects to create an entertaining spectator experience for the live marketplace bidding phase.

ideas.pitch: A browser extension game layer that lets players chat via voice with any background NPC in retro web games using real-time generative dialogue.
ideas.title: NPC Vibe-Talker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a working live demo that transforms standard games into interactive experiences, scoring high on product creativity.

ideas.pitch: A meta-game where players build and trade AI-generated mini-games inside a simulated stock market designed specifically for the hackathon's bidding mechanic.
ideas.title: PromptMarket Tycoon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly integrates with the event's unique virtual marketplace and bidding structure, giving teams an economic edge during judging.

ideas.pitch: A physics-based racing game where players prompt car upgrades and use lightweight neural evolution to train cars to beat user tracks.
ideas.title: Evolutionary Race Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard algorithmic gameplay mechanics with fast vibe-coding iteration, appealing strongly to technical and product judges alike.
